fields.name: vptr
fields.evidence: Constructor, inlined in the fighter boma builder f_71006882d0 (near 0x7100689be8), stores vptr 0x7104f85940 and stores the object at boma+0x128. One class (fighter only).

fields.name: owner_boma
fields.evidence: Constructor stores the BattleObjectModuleAccessor with the vptr. Methods reach WorkModule via [+0x8]+0x50, StatusModule via [+0x8]+0x40, ItemModule via [+0x8]+0xC8.

fields.name: cancel_group_table
fields.evidence: Constructor stores the static address 0x7104f859b0: a {entries ptr, i32 count=2} descriptor. Each 0x18-byte entry = {u32 situation_kind at +0x0, ptr to u32 array at +0x8, i32 count at +0x10}. Entry 0: SITUATION_KIND_GROUND -> transition groups 0x1f000000..0x1f000007; entry 1: SITUATION_KIND_AIR -> 0x1f000009, 0x1f00000a, 0x1f00000c..0x1f000011 (FIGHTER_STATUS_TRANSITION_GROUP_*). Iterated by every method that enables/disables groups.

fields.name: situation_kind
fields.evidence: Helper f_71006b6150(this, situation) stores its argument here; enable_cancel (slot +0x50, f_71006b5e00) passes StatusModule prev_situation_kind (vtable +0x170); the per-frame slot +0x58 (f_71006b5f40) compares it with StatusModule situation_kind (vtable +0x168) while is_enable_cancel is true and re-applies the helper when it changed. Reset to -1 (SITUATION_KIND_NONE) by slots +0x60/+0x68 and the event handler. Initial -1.

fields.name: enable_cancel
fields.evidence: is_enable_cancel (slot +0x48, f_71006b5df0) returns the byte here. Helper f_71006b6150 sets it to (count of the entry matching the situation > 0) and then enables that entry's groups with WorkModule enable_transition_term_group (vtable +0x140), disabling the other entries' groups with unable_transition_term_group (vtable +0x148); in AIR, when ItemModule is_have_item(0) (vtable +0xC8) it also enables 0x1f00000b (GROUP_CHK_AIR_ITEM_THROW). enable_cancel export sets it to 1 at its end. Cleared by slots +0x60/+0x68. Initial 0 (16-bit zero store with +0x1D).

fields.name: cancel_locked
fields.evidence: Slot +0x60 (f_71006b5fc0) sets it to 1 (if not already set), disables every group of the table, clears enable_cancel and sets situation_kind -1. While set, enable_cancel returns early and the helper only records the situation. No clearing store found in the class's methods besides the constructor (initial 0). Bytes 0x1E..0x1F padding.

pointers.to: static cancel-group descriptor 0x7104f859b0 (2 entries of 0x18 bytes)

notes: enable_cancel (export, slot +0x50) returns without effect when any of WorkModule is_flag FIGHTER_INSTANCE_WORK_ID_FLAG_HAMMER (0x20000017), _ASSIST (0x20000040), _GENESISSET (0x20000043), _KNOCKOUT (0x2000002c) is set, or when cancel_locked. Otherwise it applies the helper with prev_situation_kind, then for status_kind FIGHTER_STATUS_KIND_ATTACK_AIR (0x36) calls WorkModule unable_transition_term (vtable +0x190) on TERM_ID_LANDING_LIGHT (0x1e00001c) and TERM_ID_LANDING (0x1e00001b), for ATTACK_LW3 (0x2c) on TERM_ID_CONT_SQUAT (0x1e000034), and sets enable_cancel=1. Slot +0x68 (f_71006b6090) = clear: disables all table groups, enable_cancel 0, situation_kind -1. Slot +0x18 (f_71006b59f0) is an event handler for message ids 0x2710..0x2713. Slots +0x28/+0x30 register/unregister a 0x28-byte listener (vptr 0x7104f85a40, callback 0x71006b6300) like ComboModule. Slots +0x38/+0x40 are empty.
